lines.en: label christmastwo10:
scene ioxmashall1
When we exit the boiler room, someone is there.
lines.zh: 我们从锅炉房出来的时候，有人在那儿。

lines.en: And, unfortunately, it’s someone perceptive enough to understand the implications of two people emerging from the dark together- one still red in the face from over exerting herself during a titjob.
lines.zh: 而不巧的是，这个人敏锐到足以理解“两个人一起从黑暗里走出来”意味着什么——其中一个还因为刚刚用力过猛地做了一次乳交而满脸通红。

lines.en: I’m beginning to think I should have rented that extra room after all.
lines.zh: 我开始觉得，当初真该多租一间房的。

lines.en: else:
And, unfortunately, it’s someone perceptive enough to understand the implications of two people emerging from the dark together.
lines.zh: 而不巧的是，这个人敏锐到足以理解“两个人一起从黑暗里走出来”意味着什么。

lines.en: Nothing happened, though.
lines.zh: 不过什么都没发生。

lines.en: Which I’m sure is hard to believe since it was Kirin and me, but...
lines.zh: 我知道，因为是我和 Kirin，这很难让人相信，不过……

lines.en: It’s the truth.
lines.zh: 这是事实。

lines.en: And now I’m burdened with having to prove that.
lines.zh: 而现在，我背上了必须证明这一点的负担。

lines.en: : Oh, it’s Io. Hi.
lines.zh: : 哦，是 Io 啊。嗨。

lines.en: : Uh...just for my own curiosity...what were you two doing in there?
lines.zh: : 呃……我只是出于好奇问一下……你们俩在里面干什么？

lines.en: : Just getting away from the party for a bit. I’m sure you know what it’s like.
lines.zh: : 只是离开派对清静一会儿。你肯定知道那种感觉。

lines.en: I try to appeal to her in the only way I know how- by making everything sound unbearable and irritating.
lines.zh: 我试着用我唯一会的方式来博得她的认同——把一切都形容得难以忍受又烦人。

lines.en: : Io?
lines.zh: : Io？

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...yeah. That’s why I’m out here too. Cause...it was irritating and...
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……对。我出来也是因为这个。因为……太烦人了，而且……

lines.en: : I’m sorry, why were you in there again? I don't think I properly registered your answer just now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你们刚才到底为什么在里面？我好像没太听清你的回答。

lines.en: : I understand getting away from everyone, but not the whole “retreating into a boiler room” part.
lines.zh: : “想躲开所有人”我能理解，但“躲进锅炉房”这部分我不懂。

lines.en: : Have you stopped and thought that maybe it was just like, extra quiet in there?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过，也许只是因为里面，怎么说呢，特别安静？

lines.en: scene ioxmashall2
: Can you do me a favor and just like, not talk for a second? Because I kind of don’t care at all about your side of the story.
lines.zh: : 能帮我个忙，那什么，先别说话吗？因为我其实一点都不在乎你那边的说法。

lines.en: : Jeez, fine. It’s not like Sensei’s side is gonna be any different, though, since we were clearly in there {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 天哪，行。不过反正老师的说法也不会有什么不同，因为我们明显是{i}一起{/i}在里面的。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall3
: Do you like her? Even after what she said about my robot? Why?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢她吗？就算她那么说我机器人的坏话之后？为什么？

lines.en: : Robot? What robot? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 机器人？什么机器人？你在说什么？

lines.en: : I don’t {i}like{/i} her, Io. We were just hanging out.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}喜欢{/i}她，Io。我们只是一起待了一会儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...this is the second time I’ve found you {i}hanging out{/i} with someone in private while everyone else is like, less than a hundred feet away.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可是……这已经是第二次了——别人都挤在一百英尺以内，我却发现你和某个人单独{i}待着{/i}。

lines.en: : Are you dating {i}her{/i} now too?
lines.zh: : 你现在也在和{i}她{/i}交往了吗？

lines.en: : Wait, are you and Ayane official, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 等等，老师和 Ayane 是正式在一起了吗？

lines.en: : {i}And{/i} Ayane? Is that why you stuck up for her back then?
lines.zh: : {i}还有{/i} Ayane？所以你那会儿才帮她说话？

lines.en: : I’m not dating anyone. And I think you might be forgetting that I was with {i}you{/i} in private the first time you caught wind of me with anyone. It wasn’t the other way around.
lines.zh: : 我没有和任何人交往。而且{i}你{/i}可能忘了，你第一次撞见我和谁在一起的时候，我身边那个人是你。不是别人。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall4
: I know I’m probably overanalyzing things again right now, but it’s kind of hard {i}not{/i} to when I go out to look for you and find you in a private room with a girl who clearly just wants to-
lines.zh: : 我知道我现在大概又在过度分析了，可是当我出来找你，却发现你和一个明显只想要——的女生单独待在一个房间里时，我很难{i}不{/i}这么想。

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} overanalyzing things. And I’d appreciate it if you’d let me talk to you without jumping down my throat.
lines.zh: : 你{i}就是{/i}在过度分析。我希望你能别一上来就冲我大吼大叫，先听我说。

lines.en: : I really wish I could but it’s kind of hard to stop talking when I get scared like this, Sensei! How many more girls are in front of me in the line?!
lines.zh: : 我真的很想，但是老师，我一害怕成这样就根本停不下来！我前面到底还排着多少个女生啊？！

lines.en: : I said I was fine with doing a little pulling but I didn't think I'd be playing tug of war against the entire class all by myself.
lines.zh: : 我说过我可以接受稍微“拉一拉”，但我没想到自己要一个人跟全班拔河。

lines.en: : What, then? Am I just not allowed to talk to anyone else without the risk of upsetting you?
lines.zh: : 那然后呢？我难道连和别人说话都得冒着惹你生气的风险吗？

lines.en: : You’re allowed to do whatever you want! I told you that!
lines.zh: : 你想做什么都行！我说过的！

lines.en: : Then stop freaking out whenever I do.
lines.zh: : 那就别在我这么做的时候动不动就崩溃。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall5
: I just wanted to spend time with you...that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想和你待在一起……就这样。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall6
: Well, hey! If you’re looking for a good place, might I recommend the boiler room?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，嘿！如果你们在找好地方，我推荐锅炉房怎么样？

lines.en: : It might not sound appealing at first, but I can guarantee you there’s plenty of room in there to do all kinds of stuff.
lines.zh: : 一开始听起来可能不怎么样，但我保证里面空间足够，想干什么都行。

lines.en: : I...didn’t mean that kind of-
lines.zh: : 我……不是那个意思——

lines.en: : You’re not helping, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 你这是在帮倒忙，Kirin。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall7
: Obviously. But if Io’s going to show up and start freaking out on you for just hanging out with me, I think it’s only fair to toss a little passive aggression back her way.
lines.zh: : 显然。不过既然 Io 一出现就因为我和老师只是待在一起而对你发飙，我觉得朝她扔点被动攻击回去也挺公平的。

lines.en: : It’s...because of the context...
lines.zh: : 是……因为那个情境……

lines.en: scene ioxmashall8
: What context? That the two of us came out of some sketchy room together when no one else was around? That context?
lines.zh: : 什么情境？是说在没别人的时候，我们俩从某个可疑的房间里一起出来？那个情境？

lines.en: : I...should just leave.
lines.zh: : 我……还是走吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, you probably should.
lines.zh: : 对，你大概该走了。

lines.en: : You don’t have to leave, Io...
lines.zh: : 你不用走的，Io……

lines.en: scene ioxmashall9
: I was actually getting ready to leave anyway! I just wanted to come say...Merry Christmas to you on the way out...
lines.zh: : 其实我本来就准备走了！我只是想在临走前来说一句……圣诞快乐……

lines.en: : There are too many people here and there’s just...too much to listen to and it’s really messing me up.
lines.zh: : 这里人太多了，而且有……太多要听的东西，真的把我搞得很糟。

lines.en: : And I know you don’t care about this and probably just want to go back to spending time with Kirin for whatever reason, but I wanted you to know that.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不在乎这个，大概只想回去继续和 Kirin 待在一起，随便出于什么原因，但我想让你知道这些。

lines.en: : You and me can...do something for Christmas next year instead. I’ll still be around, you know. I’m not going to give up on you just because basically every other girl in school is-
lines.zh: : 你和我的圣诞节……可以明年再补。你知道的，我还在。我不会因为你身边基本上有学校里其他所有女生就放弃——

lines.en: : Damn. You’ve got it really bad, huh?
lines.zh: : 靠。你陷得可真深啊，是吧？

lines.en: scene ioxmashall10
: Huh?
: For Sensei. Like...how into him are you on a scale of one to ten?
lines.zh: : 对老师。就是……一到十分，你到底有多迷他？

lines.en: : Maybe like a...nine? Ten? Eleven? Am I allowed to go past ten?
lines.zh: : 大概……九分？十分？十一分？可以超过十吗？

lines.en: : Why, though?
lines.zh: : 为什么呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean why? Why do you care?
lines.zh: : 什么叫为什么？你为什么在意？

lines.en: : I just want to know what you see in him. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道你看上他哪一点。就这样。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall11
: ...Well?
: He makes me feel...comfortable...
lines.zh: : 他让我觉得……安心……

lines.en: scene ioxmashall12
: Sensei does? Seriously? Are you on drugs or something?
lines.zh: : 老师？真的假的？你是嗑了药还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Multiple, actually. But they’re all legal and prescribed, so it’s kind of like I’m not on drugs at all.
lines.zh: : 好几种，其实。不过都是合法开处方的，所以基本上等于我没嗑药。

lines.en: : I don’t think I make you comfortable, Io.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我让你安心，Io。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall13
: You really do, though! I mean it!
lines.zh: : 你真的让我安心！我是认真的！

lines.en: : Then why are you always freaking out around me? If you’re comfortable, you should be acting...I don’t know, more comfortable.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么在我身边总是情绪失控？如果你安心的话，你应该表现得……我不知道，更自在一些。

lines.en: : Because my brain is broken, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 因为我的脑子坏掉了，老师！

lines.en: : I don’t have any impulse control and I’m afraid you’ll leave me for a girl more willing to put out than I am!
lines.zh: : 我完全没有冲动控制能力，我害怕你会为了一个比我更愿意上床的女生而离开我！

lines.en: : Not that you’re {i}with{/i} me at all in the first place! I mean, why would you be? I’m the absolute worst.
lines.zh: : 而且你本来一开始也没跟我{i}在一起{/i}！我是说，你凭什么会呢？我是最差劲的那个。

lines.en: : But I really really really like you and I can’t hold it back and the thought of you with anyone else, though well within your right, makes me want to build another wardrobe that I can crawl inside of and die.
lines.zh: : 但我真的真的真的好喜欢你，我控制不住，而一想到你和别人在一起——虽然那完全是你的自由——我就想再造一个衣柜，爬进去死在里面。

lines.en: : Have you considered...oh, I don’t know- putting out?
lines.zh: : 你有没有考虑过……嗯，比如说——上床？

lines.en: : If that’s what you think Sensei wants, why not offer it up and see if he takes the bait? Sure beats dying in some random wardrobe.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得老师想要的就是这个，为什么不主动送上去，看他上不上钩？总比死在某个随随便便的衣柜里强吧。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall14
: Because...that’s not the way I...
lines.zh: : 因为……那不是我……

lines.en: : You don’t have to explain yourself to her, Io. And you don’t really have to explain yourself to me either.
lines.zh: : 你不必向她解释，Io。其实你也不必向我解释。

lines.en: : I fully expect you to keep doing that, though, since you’d probably have a nervous breakdown without putting yourself down at least once every ten minutes.
lines.zh: : 不过我完全料到你还是会解释，因为你大概要不每十分钟贬自己一次，就得精神崩溃。

lines.en: : I’m on the brink of having a nervous breakdown right now and I’ve repeatedly insulted myself throughout this conversation.
lines.zh: : 我现在就已经在精神崩溃的边缘了，而且这整段对话里我一直在反复贬低自己。

lines.en: : Are you going to do that every time you see me with somebody else?
lines.zh: : 你每次看到我和别人在一起都要这样吗？

lines.en: : You mean every time I encounter you either hooking up or {i}finishing{/i} a hookup? Probably.
lines.zh: : 你是说每次撞见你正在勾搭别人、或者刚勾搭{i}完{/i}？大概是吧。

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: scene ioxmashall15
: Okay, Io? Listen.
lines.zh: : 好了，Io？听着。

lines.en: : P-Please don’t touch me! I’ll listen to whatever you have to say, just...
lines.zh: : 别——别碰我！你说什么我都听，只是……

lines.en: : Don’t do that...
lines.zh: : 别那样……

lines.en: scene ioxmashall16
: Oh. Uhh...okay.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……好吧。

lines.en: : I was just going to say that even if Sensei and me {i}were{/i} hooking up, it wouldn’t like, fuck up your chances with him or anything.
lines.zh: : 我本来只是想说，就算老师和我{i}真的在{/i}乱搞，也不会，怎么说，毁掉你跟他之间的机会什么的。

lines.en: : I’m not, like, dating material or whatever. And I don’t have any interest in romance at all.
lines.zh: : 我，怎么说呢，不是什么“适合交往的人”。而且我对恋爱一点兴趣都没有。

lines.en: : That sort of thing might work on Noriko, but I don’t think it makes much of a difference to Io.
lines.zh: : 这套对 Noriko 可能管用，但我觉得对 Io 没什么差别。

lines.en: : She’s made it clear, almost painstakingly so, that she wants me to want her and no one else.
lines.zh: : 她已经表达得够清楚了，几乎可以说是费尽心思地——她想要我只想要她，不要别人。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall17
: Is that...really so bad?
lines.zh: : 那……真的很糟糕吗？

lines.en: : Not until it starts ruining other relationships I have.
lines.zh: : 只要它还没开始毁掉我其他的感情关系就不算。

lines.en: : I mean...this didn’t ruin shit for me. I’m kind of used to being around people who want to spend the rest of their life with you or whatever other sappy bullshit they’re always saying.
lines.zh: : 我是说……这事儿可没毁掉我的什么。我挺习惯身边围着那种“想和你共度余生”的人，或者他们老爱说的那种肉麻废话。

lines.en: : Sure, but you’re kind of like an inverse Io where you’re always pointing out your flaws and embracing them rather than letting them consume you.
lines.zh: : 当然，不过你有点像是反过来的 Io——你总是把自己的缺点指出来、拥抱它们，而不是让它们把你吞掉。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall18
: See? I told you we’d make good friends.
lines.zh: : 看吧？我就说我们会成为好朋友。

lines.en: : Uhh...no. I’m still going to pass.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。我还是算了。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall19
: Io, I know in whatever world you’ve dreamt up for yourself that you’re this...irreparable trash heap completely immune to changing-
lines.zh: : Io，我知道在你给自己幻想出来的那个世界里，你就是这么一个……无可救药的垃圾堆，完全不可能改变——

lines.en: : But you’re going to {i}have{/i} to change if you ever want to make it through even an hour without having a self-deprecative emotional breakdown.
lines.zh: : 但如果你想哪怕撑过一个小时不闹一次自我贬低的情绪崩溃，你就{i}必须{/i}改变。

lines.en: : It’s extremely exhausting sometimes. All I did was walk out of a room and you looked like you were about to shatter into a million pieces.
lines.zh: : 有时候真的非常累。我不过是走出一个房间，你就看起来像是要碎成百万片。

lines.en: : I really felt like I was going to, though.
lines.zh: : 可我当时真觉得自己就要碎了。

lines.en: : That’s exactly the problem. Do you really think I’m going to want to be around you more if I have to constantly walk all over eggshells just to get to you? No. Of course not.
lines.zh: : 这正是问题所在。你觉得，如果我每次想靠近你都得小心翼翼如履薄冰，我还会想多和你待在一起吗？不会。当然不会。

lines.en: : Then I’ll...build a bridge over them or something! It’s not like I {i}want{/i} to be impulsive and clingy and annoying! I just am! I warned you about this!
lines.zh: : 那我就……在那些冰上搭座桥什么的！我又不{i}想{/i}要这么冲动、这么黏人、这么烦人！我本来就是！我警告过你的！

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure I’ve warned you that I’m not going to completely drop everything else other than you just to make you comfortable.
lines.zh: : 而我好像也警告过你，我不会为了让你舒服就把你以外的一切都彻底放下。

lines.en: : I think this is one of those times where you’ll just...kind of have to be uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这就是那种你必须……稍微忍一忍不舒服的时候。

lines.en: : I told you nothing happened. You can either believe me or not believe me. That’s up to you.
lines.zh: : 我说了什么都没发生。你可以信，也可以不信。随你。

lines.en: : But don’t just get all accusatory again if this happens in the future. Actually, not {i}if{/i}. When.
lines.zh: : 但以后再发生这种事，别又上来一通指责。其实不是{i}“如果”{/i}，是“迟早”。

lines.en: : If you can promise me you’ll at least {i}try{/i} to do that...
lines.zh: : 如果你能答应我至少会{i}试着{/i}做到……

lines.en: : Then I guess I can promise you I’ll at least {i}try{/i} to take you to an amusement park some day.
lines.zh: : 那我大概也能答应你，至少会{i}试着{/i}哪天带你去一次游乐园。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall20
: Uhhhhh...I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know if it’s just more of that make believe world of self loathing you were alluding to earlier playing tricks on me, but I’m pretty sure you just jumped from scolding me to making my dreams come true.
lines.zh: : 我不知道是不是你之前提到的那个自我厌恶的幻想世界又在耍我，但我敢肯定你刚刚从训我直接跳到了帮我实现梦想。

lines.en: : I haven’t done anything yet. And to be honest, I don’t even like amusement parks.
lines.zh: : 我还什么都没做呢。说实话，我甚至不喜欢游乐园。

lines.en: : But if taking you to one is enough to maybe motivate you into not being so neurotic all the time, I can deal with it.
lines.zh: : 但如果带你去一次就足以激励你别总是这么神经质，我能忍。

lines.en: : I mean...I {i}love{/i} the idea. But I’m not exactly sure how possible it is for me to change at this point since I’m so set in my ways.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我很{i}喜欢{/i}这个主意。但我不确定到了现在这个地步我还能不能改变，毕竟我已经这么积重难返了。

lines.en: : Do I get to come to this amusement park or is this just like a...G-rated boiler room kinda thing for the two of you?
lines.zh: : 那我能去这个游乐园吗，还是说这就是你们俩的……那种 G 级锅炉房之类的东西？

lines.en: : The latter. Do we have a deal, Io?
lines.zh: : 后者。成交吗，Io？

lines.en: scene ioxmashall21
: Yes, but...like I said, I don’t know if I’ll be able to follow through on it. I’m notoriously bad at changing and...communicating and...pretty much everything that doesn’t involve my hands.
lines.zh: : 好，不过……就像我说的，我不知道自己能不能做到。我是出了名的不擅长改变，还有……沟通，还有……基本上除了动手以外的一切。

lines.en: : There’s a joke to be made here, but I’m pretty sure this isn’t the time.
lines.zh: : 这里本来有个可以开的玩笑，不过我觉得现在不是时候。

lines.en: : It’s not. We’ve already been out here way too long.
lines.zh: : 确实不是。我们出来已经太久了。

lines.en: : We should probably be getting back to the party now before anyone thinks all {i}three{/i} of us were in the boiler room together.
lines.zh: : 我们大概该回派对去了，免得有人以为我们{i}三个{/i}一起待在锅炉房里。

lines.en: : Hot. And not just because it’s, like...a boiler room.
lines.zh: : 好火辣。而且不只是因为那是，怎么说……锅炉房。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall22
: Okay...I’m going to just...go back to the dorm now.
lines.zh: : 好吧……我就……回宿舍了。

lines.en: : It’s probably a bad idea for me to stick around when I can’t get my mind into the right place anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我现在也没法把脑子调整到正确的状态，留下来大概不是什么好主意。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because I’m pretty sure Uta is going to get upset about that.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？我敢肯定 Uta 会为此伤心的。

lines.en: : Uta will live. She’ll have more fun without me anyway.
lines.zh: : Uta 死不了。没有我她反而玩得更开心。

lines.en: : Let me come with you.
lines.zh: : 让我跟你一起走。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall23
: Uhh...

lines.zh: : 不行吗？……

lines.en: : Why not? I’m bored as shit here and was probably going to wind up going home anyway.
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？我在这儿无聊死了，本来大概也要回家的。

lines.en: : Because I don’t like you? I thought I made that pretty clear throughout the course of this conversation.
lines.zh: : 因为我不喜欢你？我以为这段对话里我已经说得很清楚了。

lines.en: : So what? I hang out with people I don’t like all the time.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？我经常和自己不喜欢的人混在一起。

lines.en: : It’s also dark and we’re less likely to get assaulted if we’re not alone.
lines.zh: : 而且天也黑了，两个人一起走更不容易被袭击。

lines.en: : That’s...actually a surprisingly decent reason, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 这……其实是个意外像样的理由，Kirin。

lines.en: : Yeah well, I’m a surprisingly decent person sometimes.
lines.zh: : 哼，我有时候确实是个意外像样的人。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall24
: Will walking home with Kirin bring me one step closer to the amusement park?
lines.zh: : 和 Kirin 一起走回家，能让我离游乐园更近一步吗？

lines.en: : It’s a start. Just don’t kill her on the way home. I’d be the last one to see you two together and I really don’t want to be questioned by the police.
lines.zh: : 算是个开始。只要别在回家的路上干掉她就行。我会是最后一个看见你们俩在一起的人，我可不想被警察问话。

lines.en: Especially not with my semen still in Kirin’s system.
lines.zh: 尤其是 Kirin 体内还留着我的精液。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall25
: Then...fine. But I’m probably going to either just ignore you or say a bunch of annoying shit that’ll make you think less of me as a person.
lines.zh: : 那……好吧。不过我大概会要么干脆无视你，要么说一堆烦人的废话，让你更看不起我这个人。

lines.en: : I don’t know if anything I say will be annoying, but I can definitely see some of it leading to the whole “less of a person” part as well.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我说的话会不会烦人，但我敢肯定有些话确实会导向“更看不起我这个人”那部分。

lines.en: : Well...enjoy your walk home, then.
lines.zh: : 那……祝你们回家路上愉快。

lines.en: : I’m going to go try and explain to everyone why I disappeared for so long shortly after getting here.
lines.zh: : 我得去跟大家解释一下，为什么我刚到这儿不久就消失了这么久。

lines.en: scene black
I watch Io and Kirin leave the hotel together- an outcome I would not have expected based on the first part of our run-in tonight.
lines.zh: 我目送 Io 和 Kirin 一起离开酒店——考虑到今晚我们这次撞见的开头，这结局我可没想到。

lines.en: And while I’m not sure if they’ll still {i}be{/i} together by the time they make it back to the dorm, I'm a little proud of Io for at least trying.
lines.zh: 虽然我不确定她们回到宿舍时还会不会{i}在一起{/i}，但至少 Io 愿意试一试，我有点为她骄傲。

lines.en: And I’m proud of Kirin for miraculously not managing to make anything worse this time around.
lines.zh: 我也为 Kirin 骄傲——她这次居然奇迹般地没有把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: I just hope that this isn’t a one-off situation and that the two of them can maybe learn something from this.
lines.zh: 我只希望这不是一次性的状况，希望她们俩能从中学到点什么。

lines.en: What they’ll learn exactly, remains to be seen.
lines.zh: 至于具体能学到什么，还有待观察。

lines.en: But I’m sure that whatever future comes will be better than the ones they would have found here.
lines.zh: 但我相信，无论未来如何，都会比她们在这里能找到的那些未来更好。

lines.en: Neither of them are suited for places like this.
lines.zh: 她们俩都不适合这种地方。

lines.en: But, then again, neither am I.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我也不适合。

lines.en: I say this as I make my way back into a room I don’t belong in.
lines.zh: 我说这话的同时，正走回一间我不属于的房间。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall26
: Sensei! I’m going to ignore the fact that you were gone for so long and jump straight to asking if you heard me sing or not!
lines.zh: : 老师！我就不追究你消失这么久这件事了，直接问你有没有听到我唱歌！

lines.en: : I did. It was very impressive, Ami.
lines.zh: : 听到了。非常棒，Ami。

lines.en: : Yeah?! Do you think Niki would be proud?!
lines.zh: : 真的？！你觉得 Niki 会为我骄傲吗？！

lines.en: : Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 当然。为什么不？

lines.en: : Where have you been?
lines.zh: : 你刚才去哪儿了？

lines.en: : With Kirin and Io outside of a boiler room. It’s a long story.
lines.zh: : 和 Kirin、Io 一起待在锅炉房外面。说来话长。

lines.en: : That’s...certainly a combination of characters.
lines.zh: : 这……可真是组合奇妙的几个人。

lines.en: : Io? Who is that?
lines.zh: : Io？那是谁？

lines.en: scene ioxmashall27
: She’s another girl in our class, but she never really talks to anyone, so you probably didn’t know she existed.
lines.zh: : 她也是我们班的，不过基本不跟任何人说话，所以你大概不知道有她这么个人。

lines.en: : And she’s...friends with Kirin?
lines.zh: : 那她和 Kirin 是……朋友？

lines.en: : I...don’t think so? At least I’ve never really seen them together before.
lines.zh: : 我……不这么认为？至少我从来没见过她们俩在一起。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say they’re friends, but they're walking back to the dorms together now, so at least that’s a thing.
lines.zh: : 我不会说她们是朋友，不过她们现在正一起走回宿舍，所以至少算是有了个开始。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall28
: Kirin left? Why? She was supposed to walk back with me tonight. I would have left early if I knew she wasn’t having fun.
lines.zh: : Kirin 走了？为什么？她今晚说好要和我一起走回去的。我要是早知道她玩得不开心，就该早点走的。

lines.en: : You can leave with us instead, Karin. You spend more time hanging out in our group anyway.
lines.zh: : 那你可以跟我们一起走，Karin。反正你本来就更多时间跟我们这群人混。

lines.en: : Does them leaving have anything to do with what may have happened outside of this boiler room thing?
lines.zh: : 她们走了，跟你们在锅炉房外面可能发生的事有关系吗？

lines.en: : Maybe. Maybe not. Anyway, what have you guys been up to?
lines.zh: : 也许有，也许没有。话说回来，你们都在忙什么？

lines.en: scene ioxmashall29
: Well...I was worrying about why you and Kirin left together...but I feel kind of...really stupid for that now...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我刚刚还在担心你和 Kirin 为什么一起走了……不过现在觉得……自己挺蠢的……

lines.en: I subconsciously thank Io for showing up and becoming a part of my alibi, even if she almost broke down in the process of doing so.
lines.zh: 我下意识地感谢 Io 出现并成了我不在场证明的一部分，哪怕她在这个过程中差点崩溃。

lines.en: : That seems like a plausible thing to worry-
lines.zh: : 听起来确实是件值得担——

lines.en: : And you, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Ami？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just singing and...waiting for you. So basically what I’m always doing, but with more of a Christmas vibe.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就是唱歌，然后……等你。基本上就是我一贯在做的事，只不过多了点圣诞气氛。

lines.en: : Have you eaten anything yet? We ordered a million more cakes for the party since we finished everything at our house last night.
lines.zh: : 你吃过东西了吗？我们为派对又订了无数个蛋糕，因为昨晚在家里我们把一切都吃光了。

lines.en: : I’m assuming “we” means Maya?
lines.zh: : 我猜“我们”指的是 Maya？

lines.en: scene ioxmashall30
: I regret nothing.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不后悔。

lines.en: : I also...b...baked one if you want to try that, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我还……烤……烤了一个，老师你要不要尝尝！

lines.en: : Actually, nevermind! Don’t! I’m sure the others are better! Hahaha!
lines.zh: : 还是算了！别尝！我敢肯定别人的更好吃！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Karin, why are you laughing about that?
lines.zh: : Karin，你为什么要笑这个？

lines.en: scene ioxmashall31
: I have no idea! Hahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : So, do you intend to stay in this room for the rest of the party? Or are you bound to go wandering around again?
lines.zh: : 那么，你打算在这场派对剩下的时间里都待在这间屋子里？还是注定又要到处乱逛？

lines.en: : Worried you’ll miss me too much if I leave?
lines.zh: : 怕我走了你会太想我？

lines.en: : Quite the opposite, actually. I’m trying to plan my night so I see as little of you as possible.
lines.zh: : 恰恰相反。我是在规划今晚的行程，好让我尽量少看到你。

lines.en: It’s really amazing how she can still pretend she hates me this much even after starting to let the truth slip out.
lines.zh: 真厉害，她都开始让真相漏出来了，却还能装得这么讨厌我。

lines.en: But I guess she has plenty of experience after all those years of hating other iterations.
lines.zh: 不过想想她恨了那么多年的其他迭代，经验自然是有的。

lines.en: Or...other versions of this same iteration?
lines.zh: 或者……是同一迭代的其他版本？

lines.en: I still have no idea how it works. I’m just glad to be sentient right now.
lines.zh: 我到现在也没搞懂这到底是怎么回事。我只是很高兴自己现在是有意识的。

lines.en: : I’ll probably stick around for a little while, get pulled into some drama, come back, get pulled into more drama, and then bump into you on the roof or something.
lines.zh: : 我大概会先待一会儿，被卷进某场闹剧，回来，再被卷进更多闹剧，最后在天台上撞见你什么的。

lines.en: : That’s how things normally go, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少事情一向都是这么发展的。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall32
: Joke's on you. The roof here is closed.
lines.zh: : 你失算了。这里的天台是关着的。

lines.en: : Roof? When did you try to go to the roof?
lines.zh: : 天台？你什么时候想去天台了？

lines.en: : Is this about stars again? You know you can take a break from stars on Christmas, Maya. They’re not going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 又是因为星星吗？Maya，圣诞节你可以让自己从星星里歇一歇的。它们又不会跑掉。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall33
: Thank you, Ami. This changes everything. All this time, I was under the impression that they were just going to disappear.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Ami。这改变了一切。一直以来，我都以为它们会消失呢。

lines.en: : I can now celebrate Christmas like the normal [teenage]girl I am. Hooray.
lines.zh: : 现在我终于可以像个普通的 [teenage]女孩那样过圣诞了。万岁。

lines.en: scene ioxmashall34
: You don’t have to be a jerk about it, you know...
lines.zh: : 你也不用非得这么刻薄吧……

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}
